before.name: Elisha son of Shaphat
before.note: Prophet, Elijah's successor, who first appears as a farmer plowing with twelve yoke of oxen in 1 Kings and is later named in 2 Kings and Luke; the same prophet in all three entries.

stages.label: Elisha son of Shaphat

quotes.quote: found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him
Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.
He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him

stages.text: Elisha son of Shaphat: a man in his middle years, broad-shouldered and sun-browned from working the fields, lean and steady in build. Dark skin, short dark hair, and a close-cut beard with some grey at the chin. Calm, weathered face with deep-set eyes. Signature outfit: a plain undyed linen tunic belted at the waist with a cloak of rough brown wool. Signature prop: Elijah's mantle, a dark sheepskin cloak he wears over his shoulders.
